name: 55812 · Duluth, MN
findings: ZIP 55812 (Duluth) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55812 (Duluth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
